reported_status: The supplied Dots chain proves complete finite exterior-occupation closure at four retained original-model tuples, with exact paid source-basin correction. Earlier high-mass, full-line, actual-wall and winding certificates remain reusable at their own scopes. The corrected global-cut edition reports W_cut/ZA<=exp(-6215) at R200 under explicit directed-arithmetic/compiler assumptions. The newer four-corner candidate conditionally gives C/ZA>exp(-6267) and W/C<exp(52), contingent on its geometric/overlap and original-source interfaces. None acquires the full original-physical-time estimator or a uniform polynomial-work guarantee.

Original periodic Ising model, physical nearest-neighbor heatbath rate one per site, fixed acquired augmented-component core A=C_r, soft source clock kappa, target B={M>=0}, decreasing voltage v, capacity C and core normalizer ZA remain unchanged. Finite occupation tuples are theta4,phi4/R,L8R,(R,r)=(80,5),(200,5),(1000,6),(10000,7). F is a separately proved comparison downset containing A, not a silent replacement for original M5.
